EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm sorry,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} but could you dig out the
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}time capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} you buried for me?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}After sending you to bury it, I just
started to feel kind of silly{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}OK, you remember the place where
you buried it, right?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}This is a true
test of our friendship,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Perdona,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ¿te importaría desenterrar
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula del tiempo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que te pedí
que enterraras?
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Justo después de que te marcharas
a enterrarla me di cuenta de que
era una tontería{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Todavía te acuerdas de dónde la
enterraste, {{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿a que sí?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Venga,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, tráemela, anda.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Scusami,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ma... pensi che potresti
dissotterrare la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsula del tempo
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}che hai sotterrato per me?
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Dopo che ti ho chiesto di
sotterrarla mi sono sentito
un po' sciocco{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}OK, ti ricordi dove l'hai nascosta,
vero?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Non mi deludere,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tut mir leid,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} aber könntest du die
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zeitkapsel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, die du für mich
vergraben hast, wieder ausgraben?
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Kurz nachdem ich dich darum
gebeten hatte, kam mir die Idee
irgendwie komisch vor{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Du weißt doch noch, wo du sie
vergraben hast?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Das ist ein echter
Freundschaftstest,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Kusura bakma,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ama benim için gömdüğün
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}zaman kapsülünü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} çıkarabilir misin?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Sana
gömdürdükten sonra kendimi biraz saçma
hissetmeye başladım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tamam, nereye
gömdüğünü hatırlıyorsun, değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Bu dostluğumuzun gerçek sınavı,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Aquí estás, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} ¿Recuerdas
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula del tiempo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que te pedí
que enterraras?
Si no es mucha molestia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¿podrías traérmela?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}No te enfades conmigo.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Es que me
he dado cuenta de que enterrarla
fue una equivocación.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}About that {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}time capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} I asked you
to bury for me{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}I suddenly started to feel really
embarrassed and wanted to dig it
up myself,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I thought I'd let you know because
you helped me bury it, but I won't
need your help digging it back up.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}He tenido remordimientos desde
que te pedí que enterraras aquella
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula del tiempo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Empecé a sentir tanta vergüenza,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
que incluso decidí ir a recuperarla
yo mismo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tras cavar en medio pueblo,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} por fin
conseguí dar con ella.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Como la enterraste tú, creo que
te merecías que te avisara.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Au sujet de cette {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule
temporelle{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que je t'avais demandé
d'enterrer{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}J'ai fini par trouver cette histoire
ridicule et je me suis arrangé pour
la déterrer moi-même.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}J'ai pensé que t'aimerais le savoir,{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}si déjà tu t'es embêté{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} à aller
l'enfouir pour moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ricordi la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsula del tempo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}che
ti avevo chiesto di sotterrare?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Mi è sembrata tutta un'enorme
stupidaggine e sono andato a
dissotterrarla,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Eri stat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} così gentile ad aiutarmi a
sotterrarla e ho pensato di dirti che
me la sono andata a riprendere!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Was die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zeitkapsel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} angeht, die du
für mich vergraben solltest{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Die Sache war mir irgendwie
peinlich und ich hab sie selber
ausgegraben,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich wollte dir nur Bescheid sagen,
weil du sie ja für mich vergraben
hast.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Hani benim için gömmeni istediğim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}zaman
kapsülü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} vardı ya{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Birden çok utanmaya
başladım ve kendim çıkarıp almak
istedim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gömmeme yardım ettiğin için haber
vereyim dedim ama çıkarırken yardımına
ihtiyacım olmayacak.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Estaba cavando por el pueblo y me
topé con la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula del tiempo
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que enterraste por mí.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Fue por casualidad, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
Siento haberte molestado para
nada.
